progressSource: Production agent introduction progress projection; button admission has not yet accepted.
contextPlacement: Current decision, resource index and UI event use production runtimeInstruction; persistent Brief/Memory use talentContextSection.
messageProjection: Production formatTalentMessageContentForLlmPrompt; verified agent_introduction_action carries exact candidate intent.
regressionSource: The first seven cases are copied verbatim from frozen cases-v5.json (same IDs, profiles, modes and turns).
declineNoteContract: PR-9 (local, uncommitted at authoring time). A decline saved with the candidate's own note, for a Role whose company already knows the candidate (here: a company-originated Intro request, companyIntro=true), is admitted as a durable Career request: one user message of type opportunity_feedback_note whose payload is {opportunityDecision:{decision:'decline', recommendationId, roleId, decisionAt, note}} and whose content is buildOpportunityFeedbackNoteContent({action:'negative', sourceType:'internal', companyName, title, locale:'ko'}). It is projected with formatTalentMessageContentForLlmPrompt(..., {currentInput:true}), as the Career inbox does. The original Career LLM alone decides whether any part of the note reaches the company through contact_company with recommendationId only. turns=[null] marks that single admitted request, like an introduction button turn. The reason options the candidate ticked are not part of the input (PR-9 context minimization).
